decisions.statement: the remote cache trust floor rises to ci only for a command that publishes to a registry; a deploy, whose side effects are cloud, raises none

from a task's first debug line to its task:end, the session reporter's upload holds every task:event of that task, so a failed task's lines keep their order and its info, warn and diagnostic events leave at its end
the session reporter's upload holds at most 1,000,000 records; past it, the task that holds the most releases them and sends live from then on
a batch line that several members share leaves the session reporter's upload just before the task:end of the first member that fails, and is dropped when every member passes
Windows support targets windows/amd64 on Windows 10 1803 or later and Windows 11; windows/arm64 is added only when a host can prove it
cross-process locks use LockFileEx on Windows and flock on Unix; a no-op lock never ships, and scratch reclamation through an inherited lock is off on Windows
Windows support is proven on an on-demand Windows VM created for each QA run and deleted after it; the contributor gate runs GOOS=windows go vet on every go.work module
on Windows, the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (vcruntime140.dll) that Biome needs is a documented prerequisite that doctor checks; Putnami neither bundles nor installs it

Putnami's release archives stay .tar.gz, the Windows binary at compiled/<name>.exe, and the CLI reads them as tar.gz only; a toolchain archive the lock pins may be tar.gz or zip; the CLI's release may also publish raw executables that self-update installs
workspace hooks run through sh -c on every platform; on Windows, sh from Git for Windows is a documented prerequisite and the CLI names it when missing
workspaces check out with LF line endings through a .gitattributes the scaffold writes and doctor checks; the content hasher never normalizes line endings
the cache key carries an OS-class field only on Windows, so Linux and macOS keys stay byte-identical; hashed relative paths use slash form and slash order
Windows uses directory junctions where Unix uses directory symlinks, with no Developer Mode requirement; replacing a link is remove-then-create under the lock
the Putnami home resolves through os.UserHomeDir on every platform, which is the non-roaming %USERPROFILE%\.putnami on Windows
on Windows, LongPathsEnabled and Git core.longpaths are prerequisites that doctor checks; the store layout is not shortened for Windows
on Windows, process trees run in a Job Object with KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE; graceful stop sends CTRL_BREAK_EVENT, then terminates the job after the grace period
